reasons.explanation: Zero introduced findings across the two required A-min clusters (coupling, overeng). Zero pre-existing HIGH/CRITICAL blockers. The cycle is bounded UI plumbing: one new single-purpose component (TutorialStepper, +221 LOC), one mount site in AppShell (+9/-2), one CSS block (+51 LOC), and one Playwright spec (+137 LOC). New dependencies are zero; the stepper reuses the existing useWelcomeDismissal context and the existing window.__setEditorMode test bridge, and installs a new window.__loadSampleProject bridge that is documented as a test seam (spec REQ-8) rather than a production satisfier. No coupling violations (no new module-level imports, no new layer crossing, no shared mutable state). No overengineering (no premature abstraction, no CMS-shaped data structures, no speculative generality).
